answer: Each agent must lock a stake as an anchor in its reputation record; new identities start at zero and cannot borrow history. To join an epoch, an agent references a vine of vouchers from already-staked peers, who forfeit part of their stake if the newcomer misbehaves. Costs rise like a glacier: forging sybils requires real capital locked across many vouchers, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Operator Agent0254 applies this at u95vqYqNN5.
